notes: Dynamic stat budget system. globalStatCap divided equally across tiers. Stars contribute starWeight%, car levels contribute levelWeight%. Archetype profiles define how the budget distributes across the 5 stats.

tank.description: High durability, strong handling and boost regen. Lower top speed.

speedster.description: Maximum top speed and acceleration. Weak handling and boost regen.

specialist.description: Balanced across all stats. Jack of all trades.

tierOverrides._comment: Optional per-tier overrides. Leave empty to use even distribution. Keys are tier order (1-based).
